prompt: What was the last prose book written by the poet who referred to Wyndham Lewis as "that lonely old volcano of the Right."?
answer: The poet was **W. H. Auden**, who called Wyndham Lewis “that lonely old volcano of the Right.” Auden’s last prose book was **_Forewords and Afterwords_**, published in **1973**.
